_comment_top: spaarkeai-assistant-enhancements-r3 task 020 (FR-06 — the overview DoD driver) — seed row for the spaarke.grid_overview tool. ONE parameterized configId-driven overview tool (§11 reuse-first): it reuses each surface's EXISTING sprk_gridconfiguration saved query (sprk_fetchxml), NOT N per-grid handlers and NOT model-authored SQL. This is a Spaarke-specific capability, NOT part of the frozen GA Dataverse MCP dataverse.* namespace — hence the spaarke.* tool id.
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to GridOverviewHandler via sprk_handlerclass. Auto-discovered (ADR-010). The deterministic ADR-039 PreFilter/catalog projects the LLM-facing function name from sprk_toolid — NO classifier, NO second dispatch surface.
_comment_obo: project MUST rule: BOTH the sprk_gridconfiguration read AND the FetchXML execution run through IDataverseUserClient under the calling user's OBO token — the user's security roles + row-level security filter every row (ADR-028 / ADR-015). NO app-only path (the app-only FetchService/ServiceClient DataGrid path is NOT used here).
_comment_today: project MUST rule: `today` is injected SERVER-SIDE deterministically (from an injected TimeProvider) into the saved FetchXML's {{today}} / {{today+N}} / {{today-N}} placeholder tokens — the tool NEVER prompts for the date and NEVER trusts a client-supplied date. Derived predicates (overdue = dueDate < today) therefore resolve server-side.
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000000 (Read). The tool only executes a saved read query; it authors no SQL and performs no writes.
_comment_contrast_read_query: Contrast with dataverse.read_query, which rejects GETDATE()/COUNT/aggregates — the exact R2 UAT defect (query error + duplicate tab). This tool answers 'how many overdue tasks do I have?' by running the grid's own saved query with today injected.
_comment_grounding: ADR-039/ADR-015 grounding: every returned row carries the table primary id; each row has '@citation.path' = tables/{t}/records/{id} and adapter-level citation metadata. Telemetry logs configId + entity + counts + duration only — never FetchXML body, never row content.
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter.
_comment_wiring_r3_021: spaarkeai-assistant-enhancements-r3 task 021 (FR-07) appended the trailing 'Known configId values' sentence below — keep it byte-equal with GridOverviewHandler.Metadata.Description (guarded by GridOverviewHandlerDescriptionParityTests). The mapping publishes each grid's + Calendar's existing sprk_gridconfiguration id as static tool metadata because the per-tab workspace-state prompt block (task 011, ADR-015) is trimmed to {type,label,active} only and cannot carry a configId. GUIDs mirror ENTITY_VIEW_CONFIG_IDS (register-workspace-widgets.ts) + EVENT_CONFIG_ID (CalendarWorkspaceWidget.tsx) — the SAME rows the grids/Calendar already use to fetch data (§11 reuse; zero new Dataverse rows for grids). Daily Briefing is intentionally NOT in this table — it is a Lane-3 composed-service surface wired by the separate SYS-Daily Briefing Overview row (sprk_analysistool-daily-briefing-overview-row.json).
sprk_description: Runs a grid or workspace surface's EXISTING saved view (its configuration's FetchXML), addressed by configId, under the calling user's permissions, and returns an accurate record count plus grid-shaped rows with record-id citations. The current date is injected server-side automatically (overdue/due-today/due-this-week predicates resolve against today with no date needed from you) — do NOT ask the user for the date. This tool runs under the CALLING USER's identity (OBO) automatically — you already know who the user is; NEVER ask the user for their user id, name, or 'who they are' to scope results. Use this instead of dataverse.read_query whenever the user asks 'how many' / a status overview / an overdue-or-upcoming count for a known grid, because this reuses the grid's own saved query (which read_query cannot express: GETDATE(), COUNT, and aggregates are rejected there). It takes ONE required argument, configId (the sprk_gridconfiguration record id for the target grid). Returns { count, rows, entity } — narrate the count and cite the returned record ids; do not invent numbers. Known configId values for the currently-deployed workspace surfaces (reuse these directly — do not guess a GUID): Documents=1cdd19d2-3964-f111-ab0c-7ced8ddc4cc6, Matters=113ad380-9e63-f111-ab0c-70a8a53ec687, Projects=97ee98e7-7a63-f111-ab0c-70a8a53ec687, Invoices=d021827b-9b5e-f111-ab0c-7c1e521545d7, Work Assignments=9c5b0ee7-7a63-f111-ab0c-000d3a4d8152, Communications/Messages=e1826c4c-9575-f111-ab0e-7ced8ddc4a05, My Tasks=ac05e4f1-8d85-f111-8075-7c1e5268570d, Calendar/Events=5294c28a-f078-f111-ab0e-7ced8ddc4a05. For Daily Briefing questions (portfolio counts + narrative), use the daily-briefing overview tool instead — do not pass a Briefing configId here.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — this tool exists for the agent loop (P2), not playbook nodes.

sprk_jsonschema.title: spaarke.grid_overview Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: ONE required argument: the sprk_gridconfiguration record id whose saved FetchXML defines the overview to run.

configId.description: The sprk_gridconfiguration record id (GUID) for the target grid/surface. The tool runs that configuration's saved FetchXML with the current date injected server-side.
The grid configuration id that was run.

view.description: The saved view (grid configuration) display name.

entity.description: Table logical name the saved query targets.

today.description: The server date (ISO-8601) injected into the saved query — proves server-side date injection.

count.description: Accurate matching record count (from returntotalrecordcount) or the returned-row count as a lower bound.

items.description: Selected columns plus '@citation.path' (tables/{t}/records/{id}) and the primary id column.

sprk_configuration._comment: No method-discriminator dispatch — single LLM-facing function. configId is supplied per-call by the model (surface-agnostic); task 021 wired the concrete grid + Calendar configIds into sprk_description above (Daily Briefing is a separate tool/row — see sprk_analysistool-daily-briefing-overview-row.json).
